Will I get a replacement or a refund?
Whether you receive a replacement or a refund depends on your situation:
For returns of orders, you receive a refund to your original payment method after the return is received and reviewed (usually within about 8 business days).
For damaged products, we first assess if the damage is repairable and/or covered by warranty. In many cases, we provide repairs or replacement parts, sometimes free of charge; some damages may be beyond repair or not covered. We always review each case individually to find the best possible solution, but the sources do not state a general right to a full replacement product instead of repair.
So you may get a refund (for an eligible return) or repair/replacement parts (for eligible damage); which applies to you depends on whether you’re returning an item or seeking a repair under warranty.
